purpose: Exploratory capacity check (edgex, k4): does the platform exceed 500 msg/s? Warm-up 120 s at 50, then 3-minute constant-rate steps; judged offline by benchctl explore with the rule declared in docs/exploratory-capacity.md. 1000 devices round-robin so one device's messages are >= 1 s apart at 1000 msg/s (ThingsBoard keys telemetry by device and arrival ms). Not a paper result.
deviations: Outbound delivery to the Go sink on ramonavm1 configured for the measurement (scripts/outbound.sh); setup, not tuning.
1000 devices round-robin (one device's messages >= 1 s apart at 1000 msg/s).

Provision-then-scale (user decision 2026-10-22): devices are created at one device-rest replica, then the deployment is scaled to N (edgex/scripts/provision-then-scale.sh), because adding a device with several replicas makes core-metadata panic (docs/findings/edgex-device-validation-panic.md). Same procedure at every k. Setup gate before the run; a core-metadata panic/restart during the run makes the run FAIL (platform defect).
app-service-configurable http-export (profile export) added in the application pool for outbound observation.
